readerCopy.body: The short version says the plan is a major success, while the full report describes mixed results and important limits. One side argues that the larger message will attract support; the other warns that the simplified claim changes what the evidence actually says. Mercury holds the details, wording, and exceptions, while Jupiter gives the broad conclusion more reach and authority. The opposition places the useful headline across from the facts it leaves behind. The message may win attention, but the credibility of the project rests on whether the fuller version is allowed to travel too.
